literal: In the fifth month, on gengwu day, he held a Dragon Boat Festival feast for the assembled ministers and envoys of the various states, ordering the Uyghur and Dunhuang envoys to perform their native dances for the other envoys to watch.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengwu day, he feasted his ministers and the envoys of every tributary state for the Dragon Boat Festival and had the Uyghur and Dunhuang ambassadors dance in their own styles so the rest might see them.

literal: On gengchen day, Jin sent envoys presenting bows and arrows.
idiomatic: On gengchen day Jin sent envoys with bows and arrows as tribute.

literal: On jiashen day, he dispatched the prince Tiande and Acting Director of the Department of State Affairs Di Yonghe as envoys to Jin.
idiomatic: On jiashen day he sent Prince Tiande and Acting Director of the Department of State Affairs Di Yonghe as envoys to Jin.

literal: On wuzi day, he reviewed cavalry in the southern suburb.
idiomatic: On wuzi day he reviewed the cavalry in the southern suburb.

literal: On the yiwei new moon of the sixth month, Eastern Capital Chancellor Yelü Yuzhi reported that Bohai Chancellor Da Suxian was unlawful; an edict ordered aides and the populace to recommend a talented and virtuous person to replace him.
idiomatic: At the yiwei new moon of the sixth month, Eastern Capital Chancellor Yelü Yuzhi reported that Bohai Chancellor Da Suxian had broken the law; an edict called on his staff and the people to nominate a worthy successor.

literal: On bingshen day, he reviewed infantry in the southern suburb.
idiomatic: On bingshen day he reviewed the infantry in the southern suburb.

literal: On gengzi day, Jin and Kala Guzhi sent envoys to pay court.
idiomatic: On gengzi day envoys from Jin and Kala Guzhi came to court.

literal: On renyin day, the imperial carriage departed Yanjing; Zhongshu Ling Xiao Sengyin was ordered to muster armies from all circuits at Changzuo Camp.
idiomatic: On renyin day the court left Yanjing; Zhongshu Ling Xiao Sengyin was ordered to assemble the armies of every circuit at Changzuo Camp.

literal: On guichou day, the court halted at Fengsheng Prefecture.
idiomatic: On guichou day the imperial train halted at Fengsheng Prefecture.

literal: On jiayin day, he rewarded the soldiers.
idiomatic: On jiayin day he rewarded the troops.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jisi day, he hunted at Huadilie Mountain.
idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month, on jisi day, he hunted at Huadilie Mountain.

literal: On guiyou day, he attended court with the Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: On guiyou day he attended the Empress Dowager at court.

literal: On bingzi day, he accompanied the Empress Dowager to visit the Human Sovereign King's consort, who was ill.
idiomatic: On bingzi day he went with the Empress Dowager to visit the Human Sovereign King's consort, who lay ill.

literal: On wuyin day, the Human Sovereign King's consort, née Xiao, died.
idiomatic: On wuyin day the Human Sovereign King's consort, née Xiao, died.

literal: On jimao day, because An Chongrong held Zhen Prefecture and rebelled against Jin, an edict ordered the Southern Campaign General Liu Yan to prepare border defenses.
idiomatic: On jimao day, with An Chongrong holding Zhen Prefecture in revolt against Jin, an edict ordered Southern Campaign General Liu Yan to strengthen the frontier.

literal: On bingxu day, the Human Sovereign King's traveling palace was moved to the place where his consort died.
idiomatic: On bingxu day the Human Sovereign King's traveling palace was moved to the place where his consort had died.

literal: On xinmao day, Jin sent envoys requesting permission to perform the Southern Suburb rite; permission was granted.
idiomatic: On xinmao day Jin sent envoys asking leave to sacrifice at the Southern Suburb; leave was granted.

literal: In the eighth month, on jihai day, an edict ordered Eastern Dan officials and people to observe mourning for their king Bei's consort, née Xiao.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jihai day, an edict ordered the officials and people of Eastern Dan to mourn their king Bei's consort, née Xiao.

literal: On gengzi day, Tlübu came with tribute.
idiomatic: On gengzi day Tlübu brought tribute.

literal: On renyin day, envoys were dispatched to Southern Tang.
idiomatic: On renyin day envoys were sent to Southern Tang.

literal: On yisi day, Tlübu, the Black Cart Shiwei, Zhenlie, and other states came with tribute.
idiomatic: On yisi day Tlübu, the Black Cart Shiwei, Zhenlie, and other states brought tribute.

literal: Southern Tang sent envoys requesting blue felt tents; they were granted.
idiomatic: Southern Tang sent envoys asking for blue felt tents, and they were granted.

literal: On wushen day, Anduan's private city was made Baichuan Prefecture.
idiomatic: On wushen day Anduan's private city was established as Baichuan Prefecture.

literal: On xinhai day, the envoys from Bigude requested the bestowal of titles; they were given the rank of chancellor of their state.
idiomatic: On xinhai day Bigude's envoys asked for titles to be conferred, and they were granted the rank of chancellor of their state.

literal: On jiayin day, Tlübu came with tribute.
idiomatic: On jiayin day Tlübu brought tribute again.

literal: On yimao day, the official staff of Baichuan Prefecture was established.
idiomatic: On yimao day the official staff of Baichuan Prefecture was appointed.

literal: On bingchen day, an edict granted land near the Yuhelili River and the Luchqu River as farmland to the Southern Court's Ojintulü, Yisibo, the Northern Court's Wennahala, and the Three Shilie clans.
idiomatic: On bingchen day an edict granted land near the Yuhelili and Luchqu rivers as farmland to the Southern Court's Ojintulü and Yisibo, the Northern Court's Wennahala, and the Three Shilie clans.

literal: In the ninth month, on gengwu day, Palace Attendant Cui Qionggu said: "The Jin ruler has heard that Your Majesty hunts frequently and wishes to ask you to restrain yourself.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengwu day, Palace Attendant Cui Qionggu said, "The Jin ruler has heard that Your Majesty hunts often and wishes to ask you to show restraint.

literal: " The emperor said: "My hunting is not merely for pleasure; it is to drill in military affairs.
idiomatic: " The emperor replied, "My hunting is not mere diversion; it is training for war.

literal: " An edict was issued to inform Jin accordingly.
idiomatic: " An edict was then issued to explain this to Jin.

literal: On renwu day, border commanders reported defeating the Tuyuhun and capturing their chieftain;
idiomatic: On renwu day frontier commanders reported a victory over the Tuyuhun and the capture of their chieftain;

literal: an edict ordered that only the ringleaders and able-bodied men be put to death; the rest were all released.
idiomatic: an edict ordered that only the ringleaders and fighting men be executed; all the rest were released.

literal: On bingxu day, Jin sent envoys presenting fine horses.
idiomatic: On bingxu day Jin sent envoys with fine horses as tribute.

literal: On wuzi day, the Jurchen and the King of Wuyue sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On wuzi day the Jurchen and the King of Wuyue sent envoys bearing tribute.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on xinchou day, Kelang was dispatched as envoy to Wuyue and Lüegu as envoy to Southern Tang.
idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on xinchou day, Kelang was sent to Wuyue and Lüegu to Southern Tang.

literal: On gengshen day, Jin sent envoys presenting cloth and requesting permission to perform sacrifice personally at Mount Heng; permission was granted.
idiomatic: On gengshen day Jin sent envoys with cloth and asked leave to sacrifice in person at Mount Heng; leave was granted.

literal: In the eleventh month, on jisi day, Southern Tang sent envoys bearing sealed wax-ball dispatches reporting Jin's secret affairs.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jisi day, Southern Tang sent envoys with sealed wax-ball dispatches reporting Jin's secret affairs.

literal: On dingchou day, an edict ordered the relevant offices to teach the people sowing and spinning.
idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict ordered the relevant offices to teach the people sowing and weaving.

literal: The law whereby, on the death of an elder sister, a younger sister could succeed her in marriage was abolished.
idiomatic: The law allowing a younger sister to succeed an elder sister in marriage after the elder's death was abolished.

literal: On the renchen new moon of the twelfth month, he led the hundred officials to pay homage at the Taizu traveling palace.
idiomatic: At the renchen new moon of the twelfth month he led the hundred officials to pay homage at the Taizu traveling palace.

literal: On jiawu day, after the firewood-burning rite was completed, sacrifice was performed at the spirit tent.
idiomatic: On jiawu day, when the burnt-offering rite was finished, sacrifice was performed at the spirit tent.

literal: On bingshen day, envoys were dispatched to Jin.
idiomatic: On bingshen day envoys were sent to Jin.

literal: On bingchen day, an edict ordered that Khitan given Han offices follow Han ritual and were permitted to marry Han people.
idiomatic: On bingchen day an edict ordered Khitan who received Han offices to follow Han ritual and permitted them to marry Han people.

literal: On dingsi day, an edict ordered a Cool Hall built on the southwest battlement of the Yanjing Imperial City.
idiomatic: On dingsi day an edict ordered a Cool Hall built on the southwest wall of the Yanjing Imperial City.

literal: That winter, the court encamped at San Dian.
idiomatic: That winter the court encamped at San Dian.

literal: In the spring of the fourth year, on the first month's renxu day, widows and widowers of the Yishi, Pinbei, and Tugui Three Departments who could not support themselves were matched in marriage by the state.
idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year, on renxu day in the first month, widows and widowers of the Yishi, Pinbei, and Tugui Three Departments who could not support themselves were given spouses at state expense.

literal: On bingzi day, Southern Tang sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingzi day Southern Tang sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On gengchen day, the Niela and Wugui tribes presented captives taken from the Tangut campaign.
idiomatic: On gengchen day the Niela and Wugui tribes presented captives from the Tangut campaign.

literal: On jichou day, an edict fixed rewards for the Tangut campaign.
idiomatic: On jichou day an edict fixed rewards for the campaign against the Tangut.

literal: In the second month, on bingshen day, the Crown Prince obtained a white roe deer.
idiomatic: In the second month, on bingshen day, the Crown Prince took a white roe deer.

literal: On jiachen day, Jin sent envoys presenting fragrant medicines.
idiomatic: On jiachen day Jin sent envoys with fragrant medicines.

literal: On bingzi day, Tieli came with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingzi day Tieli brought tribute.

literal: On dingsi day, an edict ordered the relevant offices to compile a Record of the Deeds of the Founding Ancestor Qishou Khan.
idiomatic: On dingsi day an edict ordered the relevant offices to compile a Record of the Deeds of the Founding Ancestor Qishou Khan.

literal: On jiwei day, Jin dispatched Yang Yancun with tribute.
idiomatic: On jiwei day Jin dispatched Yang Yancun with tribute.

literal: He also reported An Chongrong's insubordination at Zhen Prefecture, and Yang Yancun was detained and not sent back.
idiomatic: He also reported An Chongrong's arrogance at Zhen Prefecture, and Yang Yancun was detained and not sent home.

literal: That month, An Chongrong of Zhen Prefecture in Jin seized the Liao envoy Zhuaila.
idiomatic: That month An Chongrong of Zhen Prefecture in Jin seized the Liao envoy Zhuaila.

literal: In the third month, the Uyghur envoy Kol Yuyue was specially granted office, along with banners, flags, bow and sword, clothing and horses; other gifts were bestowed in varying amounts.
idiomatic: In the third month the Uyghur envoy Kol Yuyue was specially appointed to office and given banners, flags, bow and sword, clothing and horses; other gifts were bestowed in varying measure.

literal: On guiyou day, Jin, having been permitted to sacrifice at the Southern Suburb, sent envoys to offer thanks and presented ten yi of gold.
idiomatic: On guiyou day Jin, having been permitted to sacrifice at the Southern Suburb, sent envoys to give thanks and presented ten yi of gold.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jimao day, Jin sent envoys presenting cherries.
idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, on jimao day, Jin sent envoys with cherries.

literal: In the fifth month, on gengchen day, the Tuyuhun yilijin Su and others rebelled and fled into Jin territory.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengchen day, the Tuyuhun yilijin Su and others rebelled and fled into Jin.

literal: Dieliao was dispatched with sealed dispatches to instruct Jin and the garrison commanders of Taiyuan.
idiomatic: Dieliao was sent with sealed dispatches to instruct Jin and the garrison commanders at Taiyuan.

literal: In the sixth month, on xinmao day, Zhenwu Army Deputy Military Governor Zhao Chong drove out his military governor Yelü Huali and rebelled with Shuozhou, aligning with Jin.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinmao day, Zhenwu Army Deputy Military Governor Zhao Chong drove out his military governor Yelü Huali and rebelled with Shuozhou, submitting to Jin.

literal: On bingwu day, the court ordered Commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service Naogu Zhi to Shuozhou with troops to besiege the city; when a Jin envoy arrived and requested that the gates be opened, he was not allowed and was sent under escort to the capital.
idiomatic: On bingwu day the court ordered Commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service Naogu Zhi to Shuozhou with troops to besiege the city; when a Jin envoy arrived and asked that the gates be opened, he was refused and sent under escort to the capital.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on guihai day, Southern Tang sent envoys bearing sealed wax-ball dispatches.
idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month, on guihai day, Southern Tang sent envoys with sealed wax-ball dispatches.

literal: On bingyin day, Naogu Zhi memorialized requesting that an envoy be sent to Shuozhou to summon surrender; the defenders still held the walls and would not admit him.
idiomatic: On bingyin day Naogu Zhi memorialized asking that an envoy be sent to Shuozhou to demand surrender; the defenders still held the walls and would not let him in.

literal: He also reported that Jin had tribute goods.
idiomatic: He also reported that Jin had sent tribute goods.

literal: An order was issued to bestow the tribute goods immediately upon the siege commanders.
idiomatic: An order was issued to give the tribute goods at once to the siege commanders.

literal: On jisi day, the relevant offices reported that a beehive on the spirit-banner carriage had produced honey; the diviner's reading was auspicious.
idiomatic: On jisi day the relevant offices reported that a beehive on the spirit-banner carriage had yielded honey; the diviner's reading was auspicious.

literal: On renshen day, Jin sent envoys presenting crystal inkstones.
idiomatic: On renshen day Jin sent envoys with crystal inkstones.

literal: In the eighth month, on guisi day, Southern Tang sent wax-ball dispatches.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guisi day, Southern Tang sent wax-ball dispatches.

literal: On gengzi day, Jin sent envoys presenting rhinoceros-horn bows and bamboo arrows.
idiomatic: On gengzi day Jin sent envoys with rhinoceros-horn bows and bamboo arrows.

literal: The King of Wuyue sent envoys bearing wax-ball dispatches.
idiomatic: The King of Wuyue sent envoys with wax-ball dispatches.

literal: In the ninth month, on renshen day, a comet appeared in the Jin asterism.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renshen day, a comet appeared in the Jin asterism.

literal: On dingchou day, he proceeded to Guihua Prefecture.
idiomatic: On dingchou day he traveled to Guihua Prefecture.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on xinchou day, the relevant offices reported a great harvest in Yan and Ji.
idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on xinchou day, the relevant offices reported a great harvest in Yan and Ji.

literal: On guimao day, the King of Wuyue sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On guimao day the King of Wuyue sent envoys with tribute.

literal: In the eleventh month, on bingyin day, Jin came to report that it was campaigning against An Chongrong.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingyin day, Jin sent word that it was campaigning against An Chongrong.

literal: On gengwu day, the Tuyuhun requested surrender; envoys were dispatched to reassure them.
idiomatic: On gengwu day the Tuyuhun asked to submit; envoys were sent to reassure them.

literal: Tlübu came with tribute; his gifts were bestowed on attendants of the court.
idiomatic: Tlübu brought tribute, and his gifts were given to the emperor's attendants.

literal: On bingzi day, the Jurchen of the Yalu River came with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingzi day the Jurchen of the Yalu River brought tribute.

literal: On renwu day, an edict established that the Yongning and Tianshou festivals, together with New Year's Day, the Double Fifth, the Winter Solstice, and the la sacrifice day, were all occasions for receiving congratulations.
idiomatic: On renwu day an edict established that the Yongning and Tianshou festivals, together with New Year's Day, the Double Fifth, the Winter Solstice, and the la sacrifice day, were all occasions for receiving congratulations.

literal: In the twelfth month, on wuzi day, Jin sent envoys reporting that Shannan Military Governor An Congjin had rebelled.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuzi day, Jin sent envoys reporting that Shannan Military Governor An Congjin had rebelled.

literal: An edict ordered that he be subjugated as circumstances permitted.
idiomatic: An edict ordered that he be subdued as circumstances allowed.

literal: On gengyin day, Southern Tang sent envoys bearing wax-ball dispatches.
idiomatic: On gengyin day Southern Tang sent envoys with wax-ball dispatches.

literal: On wuxu day, Jin dispatched Wang Shengluan with tribute.
idiomatic: On wuxu day Jin dispatched Wang Shengluan with tribute.

literal: On wushen day, Jin reported the defeat of An Chongrong, and Yang Yancun was then sent back.
idiomatic: On wushen day Jin reported the defeat of An Chongrong, and Yang Yancun was then sent home.

literal: On xinhai day, Jin sent envoys requesting the withdrawal of garrison troops; an edict ordered Tiyi Shuogu to withdraw his army.
idiomatic: On xinhai day Jin sent envoys asking that the garrison troops be withdrawn; an edict ordered Tiyi Shuogu to withdraw his army.

literal: On jiayin day, Shuozhou was taken by assault; Commissioner of the Crane Controllers Heli was dispatched to reward the troops.
idiomatic: On jiayin day Shuozhou was taken by storm; Commissioner of the Crane Controllers Heli was sent to reward the troops.

literal: At the time Naogu Zhi had fallen in battle below the walls; the emperor was furious and ordered the able-bodied men in the city put to death, and thirty leading households among the rebels were assigned as Naogu Zhi's retainers.
idiomatic: Naogu Zhi had by then fallen in battle beneath the walls; the emperor was furious and ordered the able-bodied men of the city put to death, and thirty leading rebel households were assigned as Naogu Zhi's retainers.

literal: In the spring of the fifth year, on the bingchen new moon of the first month, the emperor was at Guihua Prefecture; he received the ministers' obeisance from the traveling hall.
idiomatic: In the spring of the fifth year, at the bingchen new moon of the first month, the emperor was at Guihua Prefecture and received the ministers' obeisance from the traveling hall.

literal: Tribute goods from all circuits were presented to the Empress Dowager and bestowed on the imperial clan and the hundred officials.
idiomatic: Tribute goods from every circuit were presented to the Empress Dowager and bestowed on the imperial clan and the hundred officials.

literal: On wuwu day, an edict solicited frank counsel; Yelü Haisi, a gentleman of the Northern Prince's household, answered the summons; summoned for audience, his replies pleased the emperor, and he was specially appointed Commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service.
idiomatic: On wuwu day an edict called for frank counsel; Yelü Haisi, a gentleman of the Northern Prince's household, answered the summons, and when summoned to audience his replies pleased the emperor; he was specially appointed Commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service.

literal: An edict ordered Chancellor Sengyin and others to distribute Khitan households in garrison settlements along the southern frontier.
idiomatic: An edict ordered Chancellor Sengyin and others to distribute Khitan households in garrison settlements along the southern frontier.

literal: On wuchen day, Jin sent An Chongrong's head in a casket as tribute.
idiomatic: On wuchen day Jin sent An Chongrong's head in a casket as tribute.

literal: The emperor had many times wished to take the field personally against Chongrong; only now did he desist.
idiomatic: The emperor had many times wished to take the field personally against Chongrong; only now did he give up the plan.

literal: On guiyou day, envoys were dispatched to Jin.
idiomatic: On guiyou day envoys were sent to Jin.

literal: That month, Jin, with Shuozhou pacified, sent envoys to offer congratulations; the court then dispatched Guest Reception Commissioner Yelü Huage as envoy to Jin and also to present birthday gifts.
idiomatic: That month, with Shuozhou pacified, Jin sent envoys to offer congratulations; the court then dispatched Guest Reception Commissioner Yelü Huage to Jin and also to present birthday gifts.

literal: In the second month, on renchen day, as the emperor was about to make a southern progress, with several circuits still unsettled, he summoned the Crown Prince and the ministers for discussion; all said: "Though Xiang, Zhen, and Shuo have been pacified, the Tuyuhun, seduced by An Chongrong, have not yet submitted; troops should be sent to chastise them and warn the other tribes.
idiomatic: In the second month, on renchen day, as the emperor was about to travel south, with several circuits still unsettled, he summoned the Crown Prince and his ministers to discuss the matter; all said, "Though Xiang, Zhen, and Shuo are pacified, the Tuyuhun, led astray by An Chongrong, have not yet submitted; troops should be sent to chastise them and warn the other tribes.

literal: " The emperor said: "That is exactly my own view.
idiomatic: " The emperor said, "That is exactly my own view.

literal: " An edict thereupon appointed Prince Ming Weien to replace Yuyue Xinen as Southwest Route Campaign Commissioner to attack them, and the Prince of Ming was instructed to drill first in border affairs before taking up the post.
idiomatic: " An edict thereupon appointed Prince Ming Weien to replace Yuyue Xinen as Southwest Route Campaign Commissioner to attack them, and the Prince of Ming was told to drill first in frontier affairs before taking up the post.
